name: Hierarchical Grid Organization with Macrocells
definition: A hierarchical grid method that splits objects into groups based on size, clusters middle and small objects by distance, and recursively inserts smaller grids into a global grid.
summary: Hierarchical Grid Organization with Macrocells is a sparse acceleration structure that groups primitives by size and location to handle large object variance, using nested local grids and parameter-based culling to overcome standard uniform grid limitations.
